paragraphs: GreenPower Motor Company builds battery-electric buses and trucks for schools, public transit, delivery work, vanpools, micro-transit and shuttles. It began in 2010 with the goal of making battery-electric buses and trucks affordable, durable and easy to deploy.

Vehicles are built from the ground up to be electric rather than converted from existing diesel platforms. The BEAST school bus comes with air ride suspension, pass-through storage and seating for up to 90 students. The EV Star line is offered in configurations holding up to 19 passengers, with ADA wheelchair provisions or cargo delivery setups.

The first BEAST buses went to Rialto Unified School District after clearing 292 certifications from the California Highway Patrol. Corporate headquarters is in Vancouver, Canada. A sales and administration office sits in Rancho Cucamonga, California, and United States assembly takes place in Porterville. The company trades on Nasdaq under the ticker GP. Leasing options are offered to help buyers put a fleet together.

quote.text: The GreenPower chassis has been engineered to be the strongest, safest, and most durable product on the market
